author: Discovery
description:
Six teams of storm chasers track a powerful tornado outbreak across North Dakota—but as daylight fades, the situation escalates. Under the cover of night, the storm produces something rarely seen: a devastating EF5 tornado, the first of its kind in over a decade.

author: Discovery
description:
In this rare footage, storm chasers capture an anti-cyclonic tornado—spinning in the opposite direction of what you’d typically expect. It’s a phenomenon even seasoned chasers don’t often encounter, making moments like this both unpredictable and incredibly dangerous.
